m1.typescript: m1 the options register each named agent with its description prompt tools and model

e1.typescript: e1 a subagent gets read only tools by default and never the right to spawn another

e2.typescript: e2 a definition with a bad name or no description or no prompt is refused

e3.typescript: e3 depth concurrency budget and turn limits are set on the options

e4.typescript: e4 a spawn is recognised under the new and the old tool name and nothing else is

e5.typescript: e5 messages from inside a subagent are grouped under the call that started it

e6.typescript: e6 a brief carries the task and every fact the subagent needs in a fixed layout

e7.typescript: e7 findings keep the claim apart from its source and merging keeps every source

e8.typescript: e8 a run through the sdk shows the spawn the inner messages and the agents sent to the binary

wrong-allows-nesting.defect: keeps the Agent tool in a subagent's own tool list

wrong-empty-list-widened.defect: treats an explicitly empty tool list as no list and hands out the read only tools

wrong-blank-description-accepted.defect: accepts a description that is only spaces

wrong-no-depth-limit.defect: does not limit how deep subagents may nest

wrong-concurrency-fixed.defect: ignores the requested number of subagents at once

wrong-only-new-name.defect: recognises a spawn only under the current tool name

wrong-tools-repeated.defect: lists a tool once for every time it was used inside the subagent

wrong-brief-drops-facts.defect: leaves the known facts out of the brief

wrong-blank-items-kept.defect: keeps blank items as empty list lines in the brief

wrong-first-source-only.defect: keeps only the first source of a merged claim

wrong-source-in-claim.defect: writes the source into the claim text

wrong-run-keeps-nothing.defect: collects no message of the run
